instructions: Dashboard and Programme Application FAQ only. Use for short Q&A; use the paired Word document for detailed how-tos and edge cases. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour across all modules.

faqs.question: What is the Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Dashboard is the signed-in TEFConnect hub. Entrepreneurs use My Application and All Programmes. Mentors see mentorship summary cards such as assigned mentees, pending requests, and messages.

faqs.question: What is a Programme Application?
faqs.answer: It is the process to apply to a TEF programme: eligibility, overview, requirements, terms, multi-step form, preview, and submit. After submit you get a Programme ID and cannot edit the application.

faqs.question: Do I need a complete profile before applying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Incomplete profiles go to My Profile. Dashboard may show: Kindly complete your profile before starting any Programmes.

faqs.question: Is there a fee to apply?
faqs.answer: No. TEF programme applications are free to apply for.

faqs.question: What is My Application vs All Programmes?
faqs.answer: My Application shows your primary application focus. All Programmes lists programmes so you can search, start, continue, or preview.

faqs.question: How do I start a programme application?
faqs.answer: Dashboard → All Programmes → Start Application on an eligible open programme → eligibility → Overview → Requirements → Terms → Accept & Start Application → complete the form.

faqs.question: What are the application form steps?
faqs.answer: Business Information → Business Industry → Business acumen → Declaration → Programme Preview → Submit. After submit you see Application submitted with your Programme ID.

faqs.question: How do I continue or preview my application?
faqs.answer: Use Continue Application while in progress. Use Preview Application or View Application for submitted/review/final states.

faqs.question: Can I edit my application after submission?
faqs.answer: No. Once submitted it cannot be edited. Review carefully on Programme Preview before Submit Application.

faqs.question: Can I apply to more than one programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, each separately. My Application focuses on the primary card; use All Programmes for other programmes.

faqs.question: Why can’t I start a programme?
faqs.answer: Profile incomplete; not eligible; Programme Closed; Upcoming Programme; or Terms not accepted yet.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit?
faqs.answer: You see confirmation with Programme ID — save it. The application enters screening/review and email contact may follow.

faqs.question: What application statuses might I see?
faqs.answer: In Progress, Under Review, Approved, Rejected/Application Rejected. Progress % may appear. LMS PASSED can show Training Completed Successfully, proceed to Pitching; FAILED shows Did not Complete Training.

faqs.question: What is the Business acumen step?
faqs.answer: A timed test with Start Test, navigation, Submit, and Retake Test when allowed. Declarations and the test must be done before preview when required.

faqs.question: What happens on Terms & Conditions?
faqs.answer: Overview → Requirements → Terms. Tick acceptance, then Accept & Start Application. Decline & Exit leaves without starting.

faqs.question: What else is on the entrepreneur Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Notice Board, search on All Programmes (up to 50 words), Read More/Less, and links into Training/Pitching when available.

faqs.question: What does the mentor Dashboard show?
faqs.answer: Select Programme filter and cards: Total Assigned Mentee, Pending Mentee Requests, Total Messages, Responded Messages, Not Responded Messages. No entrepreneur application tabs. Unapproved mentors go to Mentorship profile.

faqs.question: What files can I upload in the application?
faqs.answer: Where offered: images JPG/PNG/GIF/WEBP; documents JPG/JPEG/PNG/PDF/DOC/DOCX. Exact fields and size rules depend on the programme form and server.

faqs.question: What should I not expect on Dashboard / Application?
faqs.answer: Do not expect to edit after submit. Mentor Dashboard does not run entrepreneur applications. My Application is not a full multi-application switcher. Questions are programme-specific.

faqs.question: How do I apply from Home?
faqs.answer: Use Apply To Open Programmes or Start Programme / Continue / Preview on cards, or View All Programmes, then follow eligibility and overview into the form.

faqs.question: What does Accept & Start Application do?
faqs.answer: It accepts terms, creates your application, and opens the application form with an application/Programme ID.

faqs.question: What is Programme Preview?
faqs.answer: A read-only review of your answers before Submit Application, with Edit Application if you still need changes before submit.

faqs.question: Why am I told I am not eligible?
faqs.answer: The eligibility check blocked the start. Follow the blocking reasons shown, or You are not eligible for this programme.

faqs.question: What does Programme Closed mean?
faqs.answer: The programme end date has passed and Start Application is not available.

faqs.question: What does Upcoming Programme mean?
faqs.answer: The programme is not open to start yet; the button is disabled.

faqs.question: How many programmes show per page in All Programmes?
faqs.answer: 12 per page.

faqs.question: Training shows FAILED on My Application. What now?
faqs.answer: Did not Complete Training messaging appears and Preview/Continue for that LMS outcome state is hidden. Mentorship is also disabled in TEFConnect when LMS is FAILED.

faqs.question: Training shows PASSED. What next?
faqs.answer: Dashboard may say Training Completed Successfully, proceed to Pitching. Open Pitching when pitching status allows.

faqs.question: Are application questions the same for every programme?
faqs.answer: No. Questions come from each programme’s form structure.

faqs.question: Where do I find my Programme ID?
faqs.answer: On the Application submitted success screen after Submit Application. Save it for later programme stages.

faqs.question: Can mentors start programmes from Dashboard?
faqs.answer: No. Mentors do not get entrepreneur application tabs.

faqs.question: What buttons appear on Programme Overview before terms?
faqs.answer: Continue and Cancel on earlier steps; on terms: Decline & Exit and Accept & Start Application.

faqs.question: I already submitted. Can Continue Application edit it?
faqs.answer: No. Submitted applications reopen as non-editable submitted/preview states.

faqs.question: How do I open All Programmes quickly?
faqs.answer: Dashboard tab All Programmes, or Home Apply To Open Programmes / View All Programmes paths into Dashboard programmes.

faqs.question: What is Declaration?
faqs.answer: A Yes/No declaration step with required follow-ups as configured before preview.

faqs.question: Can I retake the acumen test?
faqs.answer: Retake Test appears when retakes are allowed by the programme/test rules.

faqs.question: Is there a fixed max file size on application uploads?
faqs.answer: No fixed member-facing MB cap is defined in this application form area; server rules may still reject oversized files.

faqs.question: What is Notice Board?
faqs.answer: A Dashboard notice area entrepreneurs can open for notices.

faqs.question: What does Application Rejected mean?
faqs.answer: Your application was rejected. You can Preview Application or View Application as offered.

faqs.question: Do I need to accept terms every time?
faqs.answer: You accept terms when starting an application via Accept & Start Application after ticking the acceptance checkbox.

faqs.question: Why does My Application show only one programme?
faqs.answer: My Application focuses on the primary application card. Use All Programmes for other programmes.

faqs.question: What is Start Programme on Home?
faqs.answer: A card action that starts or continues into the programme application flow similar to Dashboard Start/Continue.

faqs.question: What emails might I get after applying?
faqs.answer: You may be contacted by email about eligibility and next steps after screening/review.

faqs.question: Are mentor Dashboard cards clickable into Mentorship?
faqs.answer: Mentor summary cards are display summaries; detailed mentee management is under Mentorship sections.

faqs.question: Can I go Back to Dashboard during the form?
faqs.answer: Yes. Back to Dashboard is available among navigation actions during the application wizard.

faqs.question: What does Save & Continue do?
faqs.answer: It saves the current step and moves to the next named step (Business Industry, Acumen, Declaration, or Programme Preview).

faqs.question: Does Pitching under Dashboard mean the same as Pitching module?
faqs.answer: Pitching reached from Dashboard is the Pitching module area, separate from filling the application form.

faqs.question: Unapproved mentor tried Dashboard.
faqs.answer: Unapproved mentors are redirected to Mentorship profile with a pending-approval message.

faqs.question: Can I apply without Accept & Start Application?
faqs.answer: No. Starting the live application requires accepting Terms & Conditions when that step is shown.

faqs.question: Is /application the live wizard?
faqs.answer: The live entrepreneur application wizard is Programme Overview then complete-application form. Do not treat legacy/mock application previews as the live flow.
